title: agents.continue_work request
description: P086: MCP request schema for agents.continue_work command.

agent_execution_id.description: UUID of the AgentExecution to continue.

run_id.description: Optional expected Run id. When present, it must match the AgentExecution run.

stage_execution_id.description: Optional expected StageExecution id. When present, it must match the AgentExecution owner.

session_generation_id.description: Optional expected live session generation id. When present, it must match the AgentExecution session.

provider_session_id.description: Optional expected provider-native session id. When present, it must match the live session binding.

operator_instruction.description: Operator or lead instruction to include in the canonical mode-reset continuation prompt.

max_turns.description: Maximum provider turns for the continuation prompt.

max_wall_clock_seconds.description: Maximum wall-clock seconds for the continuation prompt.

lead_decision_artifact_id.description: Required for lead_auto: ID of the lead_continuation_decision_v1 artifact.

lead_decision_artifact_sha256.description: Required for lead_auto: lowercase hex SHA-256 (64 chars) of the decision artifact bytes.

continuation_instruction_sha256.description: Required for lead_auto: lowercase hex SHA-256 (64 chars) of the instruction text.
